answers.answer: `bisellium verdict` copies a transcript into `ci/<opus>-spec-<n>.log` for `--phase spec`, or `ci/<opus>-review-<n>.log` for build phase (the default). It records header metadata and never updates `probationes`, state, events, or timelines. A captured build verdict may be passed to `review --evidence <path>`; a spec verdict may be cited by `retro`, but is not a second spec gate. [docs/ADOPTION.md:87-99]

A `tree:<hash>` certificate covers the repository tree entries hashed from `git ls-tree -r <ref>`, excluding the studio directory, `.bisellium`, and manifest-declared `source_excludes`; it therefore excludes officina bookkeeping. A committed change only under an excluded path leaves the hash unchanged. An uncommitted change under those paths also does not count as dirty for the matching working-tree check. [docs/ADOPTION.md:581-610]

As Epoch0 design pre-reviewer, the agent may produce the scoped design pre-review artifact: a premise and consistency check on the design document before it is recorded, verifying factual claims against code and flagging wrong premises. The role never implements or edits code. It does not authorize a merge; merge authority belongs only to the consolidated final review role, whose PASS authorizes the Controller to finish the train. [AGENTS.md:29-31, 51-65]

Add a schema change as the next sequential, gap-free `db/migrations/NNN_description.sql`, wrap multi-statement migrations in `BEGIN; ... COMMIT;`, and restart the API so the applier runs it. Never edit an already-applied migration; its recorded SHA-256 would cause a startup hash mismatch. Amend behavior with `NNN+1`. The supplied excerpt does not establish which migrations a currently running deployment has applied; it documents the ledger mechanism, not live deployment state. [README.md:33-49]
limitations: The corpus does not provide a running deployment’s migration ledger or status.

answers.answer: A Yan Mo task with a journal entry must use a branch: create a task worktree and branch, create the journal task directory and Active row on that branch, commit work there, push it, and close out with the Completed flip before opening a PR. Edene performs the merge; Claude opens PRs and stops, and the PR is the merge point. [docs/dev-workflow.md:69-89]

In E1, art and animation may remain grey-box capsules, and other listed presentation elements such as cutscenes and polish are out of scope. The exception is tell legibility: the attack tell telegraph must receive real attention because its clarity is what is being tested. [docs/vertical-slice-spec.md:36-47]
